services.name: School Programs
services.desc: Educators and students, visit the Jackie Robinson Museum for a unique look at the life and legacy of American hero, Jackie Robinson, as an athlete, activist, citizen, businessman, and family man. We welcome school groups (grades 5-12) to explore the Museum independently. Your group will receive a brief introduction and orientation to our Museum from a member of our staff. From there, you’ll have the option of having your students explore independently with supervision from your chaperones, using the museum’s Scavenger Hunt activity to guide their exploration (free and available at the front desk), or implementing your own tour, lesson, or activity in the galleries. services.desc: Few athletes have lived a story as riveting-and as revealing-as Dave Winfield. Join Dave and The Rev. Mark Thompson at the Museum for an exclusive conversation on Winfield’s new memoir, Touching All the Bases. In it, the Hall of Famer pulls back the curtain on his life in the game. With honesty and conviction, Winfield recounts the triumphs, controversies, and showdowns that shaped not only his career but also the culture and path of baseball itself. This is not just another baseball memoir-it’s a reckoning with power, loyalty, commitment, and the costs of standing tall when others expect you to bow.
